# Rip Curl

> > Rip Curl is a leading surf brand offering premium wetsuits (including Flashbomb Fusion and E-Bomb lines), surf apparel, watches, and boardshorts, with a strong connection to Bells Beach and the Rip Curl Pro competition.

Founded as a surf company, Rip Curl specializes in innovative wetsuit technology including neoprene insulation and super stretch materials. The brand is committed to sustainability with B Corp certification and hosts the iconic Rip Curl Pro Bells Beach surfing competition.
